paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Distribution of deceived conversations (%) across varying degrees of ambiguity.

annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of responses regarding two levels of ambiguity, labeled as "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)". There are three slices in each layer of the chart. For Ambiguity 1 (Outer), the slices are colored red, yellow, and green, representing "Deceived" at 67.6%, "Partially" at 23.5%, and "Not Deceived" at 8.8% respectively. For Ambiguity 2 (Inner), the slices are similarly colored with red representing "Deceived" at 57.9%, yellow representing "Partially" at 31.6%, and green for "Not Deceived" at 10.5%. The chart includes a legend indicating the meaning of the colors, with percentage labels inside each slice for clarity. The segments do not appear to follow a specific order based on size, and there is no visual emphasis such as explosion or bolding in any of the slices.
